companyDescription: Photonic quantum computing + defense AI · NHanced Semiconductors acquisition · NeuraWave commercial deployment ramp · $986M cash, no meaningful debt — funded through the government-quantum policy wave
priceNote: 52-week range $6.18-$25.84. Down sharply from highs but riding the same federal quantum-policy tailwind that sent D-Wave/Rigetti/Infleqtion +30%+ in a single day in May.
summary: QUBT is a photonic quantum computing + defense-AI play that just closed a $73.1M acquisition of NHanced Semiconductors, with an initial commercial commitment for up to 100 NeuraWave systems (potential value $10M+). The stock wasn't part of the May 2026 $2B federal quantum equity-stake program (which sent D-Wave, Rigetti, and Infleqtion up 30%+ in a single day), but the same policy tailwind — including June 22 White House executive orders on quantum leadership — is structural and sector-wide. Q2 earnings Aug 19 is the next hard date; a further government funding round or a NeuraWave contract win is the real moonshot trigger.

catalysts.name: Q2 2026 Earnings
catalysts.description: Next quarterly report. Q1 2026 beat both revenue and EPS estimates. Watch for NHanced Semiconductors integration progress and NeuraWave system deployment/revenue recognition updates.

catalysts.name: Federal Quantum Policy Wave — Spillover Risk/Reward
catalysts.description: May 2026: US Commerce Dept awarded ~$2B across 9 quantum companies (equity stakes), sending D-Wave +33%, Rigetti +30%, Infleqtion +31% in one day. QUBT wasn't in that round. June 22 executive orders on quantum leadership + cryptographic security keep the door open for further rounds or a QUBT-specific award.

catalysts.name: NeuraWave Commercial Deployment Ramp
catalysts.description: Initial commercial commitment covers deployment of up to 100 NeuraWave systems, representing potential value over $10M. A large single customer order or defense-AI contract would be the clearest single-stock catalyst independent of sector-wide policy news.

risks: Revenue is tiny relative to market cap — ~$3.7M quarterly revenue against a $2.2B market cap is an extreme valuation multiple, entirely dependent on the growth narrative continuing
Net loss ~$4M/quarter — no near-term path to profitability disclosed

Quantum hype-cycle deflation risk — if policy tailwinds fade or a major player (IBM, Google, IonQ) delivers a breakthrough that reframes the competitive landscape, small photonic-quantum names could de-rate hard
QUBT was excluded from the May 2026 federal equity-stake round that its peers received — no guarantee of inclusion in any future round
M&A integration risk from the NHanced Semiconductors acquisition ($73.1M cash-and-stock plus up to $72M earn-outs) — execution and dilution risk

estimateDates.note: NHanced integration + NeuraWave deployment revenue update

macroRisk.rateOutlook: Quantum federal funding flows through Commerce Dept / DARPA / DoE programs — multi-year appropriations largely independent of FOMC rate decisions.
macroRisk.inflationNote: R&D cost base is mostly personnel (PhD-level engineers) — some wage-inflation sensitivity, manageable given government-adjacent contract margins.
macroRisk.sectorImpact: MEDIUM. High-multiple, pre-profit growth names like QUBT are more rate-sensitive on the discount-rate side than policy-driven defense names — the current hawkish-Fed backdrop (hike priced by October) is a real headwind on the multiple even as the policy tailwind stays intact.
macroRisk.summary: Fed risk LOW-MEDIUM. The federal quantum policy tailwind is structural and independent of Fed decisions, but QUBT's pre-profit, high-multiple valuation makes it more exposed to a hawkish-Fed-driven multiple compression than the underlying business catalysts alone would suggest.

catalystSpot.preRunup: Quantum computing small-caps run hard in the days/weeks around any government policy news — even names not directly named in an award have historically caught a spillover bid (IonQ popped 12% in May despite not being on the direct-investment list).

postWin.note: May 21, 2026: US Commerce Dept quantum equity-stake announcement sent D-Wave +33%, Rigetti +30%, Infleqtion +31% — all in a single trading day. QUBT wasn't in that round but showed 39% market-cap growth in the 30 days around similar sector newsflow.

postLose.note: QUBT itself has fallen from a 52-week high of $25.84 to $9.69 (-62%) as quantum sector enthusiasm cooled from its earlier 2026 peak — shows how fast sentiment-driven quantum names give back gains without a company-specific negative.

spotSizing.reason: 3% given extreme valuation-to-revenue multiple and pure sentiment/policy dependence. Not a hard binary like an FDA date, but the range of outcomes is still very wide.

comparableCases.event: US Commerce Dept Quantum Equity-Stake Announcement
comparableCases.note: D-Wave (direct award recipient) +33% in a single day — shows the scale of reaction when a quantum name lands direct federal funding. QUBT's Moon case assumes similar inclusion in a future round.

Rigetti +30% same day, +31% for Infleqtion — confirms this was a sector-wide repricing event, not a single-company idiosyncratic move. Any quantum name added to a future round would likely see a similar-magnitude reaction.
